craft_problem: Adverb-stuffed dialogue tags (whispered menacingly, sneered cruelly, said angrily) attempting to do the work dialogue should do.
viewer_problem: Writers know dialogue feels flat, so they overcompensate by attaching dramatic adverbs to speech tags.
transformation: Replace the adverb tag with an action beat that proves the threat physically.
desired_learning: The dialogue and action must carry the threat. The tag cannot rescue it.
search_intent_title: Stop Using Adverbs in Dialogue Tags
novelty_reason: First dedicated dialogue craft surgery in the franchise. Shifts focus from scene setting and internal perception to interpersonal conflict and tension.
